business_problem: New Aim needed to evolve from a large retailer into an infrastructure platform that could optimize supply chain, product performance, and multi-channel commerce with AI agents, while keeping latency and incident response under control.
solution_summary: New Aim built an AI-native operating layer called AimCore on Google Cloud to manage transactions and logistics across more than forty sales channels and a 120,000-square-meter fulfillment footprint. Cloud Storage underpins a hybrid data lake for transaction and logistics data, while BigQuery serves as the core warehouse and uses native ML plus Gemini Flash models to analyze customer behavior, SKU performance, and internal telemetry at machine speed. The company also runs 24/7 internal agents through Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform, processing billions of tokens each week so planners can ask operational questions such as days of stock in plain English. Applications and transaction endpoints are deployed through Cloud Run to reduce latency for offshore operations. This stack lifted uptime, slashed incident response time, and turned what had been manual retail analysis into a continuous, AI-assisted commerce and supply-chain workflow.
